editorial:
You're dropped right into the middle of the ocean with a family celebrating their son's birthday on their boat. The mood is warm and happy until a violent storm rolls in and turns everything upside down. From there, the movie shifts into survival mode as hungry creatures from the deep start hunting them. It's a tense, edge-of-your-seat ride that mixes family drama with monster action, and you feel every wave crashing around them.

The acting feels real and grounded, and the action scenes keep you hooked without dragging. The pacing is quick, though some of the creature effects look a bit rough in places. If you enjoy survival thrillers with a sci-fi twist, this one is worth your time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the family manages to fight off the last of the creatures and reach a nearby rescue boat. The twist reveals that the storm was not natural but triggered by deep-sea drilling that woke the creatures. The father sacrifices himself to save his son, and the mother and son are rescued. The movie ends with a hint that more creatures may still be out there, setting up a possible sequel.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers with a sci-fi twist
